baseline_models.focus_anchor: The construction ليس لهم طعام إلا من ضريع negates the food predicate, then admits one source as its sole exception.
baseline_models.mechanism: Present-state negation closes the recipients' food field; the exception does not diversify that field but reduces it to the plant named by ضريع.

activation_trace.role: Fixed present-state negation supplies the clause's closed current condition.
Categorical negation makes the restriction stronger than a casual statement of scarcity.
Taste and intake supply the ordinary food function that the clause first raises and then constricts.
The named plant supplies the sole concrete item left inside the closed ration.

changed_reading.after: They occupy a closed present ration in which the whole category of food is denied and one plant-source alone is admitted.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: طعام can extend from edible matter to provision or livelihood, while ضريع carries need, submission, weakness, and emaciation.
baseline_models.mechanism: The sole allotted provision is not merely a substance associated with deprivation; its branch field embodies the recipient's need and bodily depletion, making provision reproduce want.

activation_trace.role: Provision, livelihood, and allotted share widen food into the recipients' assigned means of subsistence.
Needful submission turns the allotted provision into an enacted posture of dependence.
Weakness and emaciation supply the bodily result that this anti-provision carries within itself.

changed_reading.before: The verse identifies what they eat.
changed_reading.after: The verse identifies their entire allotted subsistence as a provision that embodies need and returns weakness instead of relief.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The food root includes ripening and taking on flavor, while a ض ر ع branch pictures a pot nearing doneness.
baseline_models.mechanism: Two readiness images converge on a meal held at the threshold of completion: it approaches flavor and doneness, yet the negative-exclusive frame never lets readiness become nourishing availability.

activation_trace.role: Present negation blocks the passage from anticipated readiness to available food.
Ripening and taking on flavor supply one trajectory toward edible completion.
A pot nearing doneness supplies a second, still-incomplete trajectory toward a meal.

changed_reading.before: The exception names a finished food item.
changed_reading.after: The exception can carry an anti-meal suspended near readiness, with completion continually approached but nutritional arrival denied.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: طعام may include drink when treated as nourishing, while ضريع also has a thin-drink branch.
baseline_models.mechanism: The sole exception slides toward the edge of the category it is supposed to restore: what remains after 'no food' may be only a thin drink, so grammatical exception and nutritional exception diverge.

activation_trace.role: Exception and exclusion supply the formal opening through which the marginal item enters.
The intake branch admits drink only insofar as it functions as tasted nourishment.
The thin-drink image pushes the only exception toward the boundary of food rather than its center.

changed_reading.before: The exception straightforwardly restores one member of the food category.
changed_reading.after: The sole exception may only grammatically restore food while materially slipping into a thin, marginal intake.

context_deltas.mechanism: Arrival, event-emergence, and envelopment enlarge the baseline restriction from a private menu fact into one operative channel of an encompassing condition.

activation_trace.role: Present-state denial supplies the local closure that the opening event can scale up.
Provision and livelihood make food a system-level condition rather than only an object.
Coming and arrival give the restrictive state an eventive onset.
Something coming to be turns static lack into a condition that has occurred.
An all-enveloping cover supplies the scale within which the closed ration operates.

structural_cues: The opening question places the focus inside an arriving, encompassing event before any food detail is given.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies arrival, emergence, and envelopment; I infer that the food restriction is one mechanism of that event. A live alternative is that the opening only frames the scene and adds no causal scale to the ration.

changed_reading.before: A group happens to possess only one bad food.
changed_reading.after: Their closed provision is one way an encompassing event takes hold of them.

context_deltas.mechanism: The sequence begins with embodied submission and exhausting work, then supplies a ration whose own branch field is emaciation, and finally denies fattening and hunger-relief. Intake therefore feeds the state of depletion rather than interrupting it.

activation_trace.role: Ordinary intake supplies the expected metabolic intervention that the mechanism reverses.
Weakness and emaciation place the body's depleted output inside the ration itself.
The face standing for the person makes the deprivation visibly embodied.
Lowered submission aligns the recipients' posture with the needful field of ضريع.
Purposeful labor supplies the energy expenditure preceding the ration.
Wearisome fatigue supplies the depleted state that food would normally repair.
Fatness as the contrary of wasting names one expected repair and explicitly removes it.
Sufficiency names the functional threshold that this ration cannot meet.
The empty belly remains as the unchanged output after intake.

structural_cues: The bodily state and exhausting labor precede the food clause; the failures of that food immediately follow it.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies exhaustion, emaciation, intake, and the explicit failure of repair; I supply the feed-forward arrow by which the ration reproduces depletion. The live alternative is simple accumulation of torments without a metabolic loop.

changed_reading.before: The ration is inadequate for already-exhausted people.
changed_reading.after: The ration is a self-maintaining metabolic trap: labor empties the body, intake returns emaciation, and hunger remains.

context_deltas.mechanism: The provision sense of طعام allows two labor-return sequences to be compared: exhausting work receives a deprivation-allotment, while purposeful striving elsewhere receives satisfaction. The focus becomes an anti-wage as well as an anti-meal.

activation_trace.role: Livelihood, earnings, and allotted share turn food into a possible return for labor.
Need and submission characterize the return assigned to the first laboring group.
Wage and worker-provision expose a compensation frame inside the earlier labor.
Work and earning supply the comparison term for a second kind of effort.
Satisfaction rather than resentment supplies the contrasting outcome of that effort.

structural_cues: The negative portrait names labor before its ration, while the positive portrait names striving immediately before satisfaction.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies labor, worker-provision, earning, and satisfaction; I infer a comparison between two returns on effort. A live alternative is that the two portraits contrast outcomes generally, not compensation specifically.

changed_reading.before: طعام denotes only what enters the body.
changed_reading.after: طعام also behaves like the allotted return on labor, and ضريع is the humiliating anti-wage paid to exhausted work.

context_deltas.mechanism: Fire, active heat, administered drink, and arrival at full maturity activate the focus's ripening and near-done-pot branches. The ration can be read as a deliberately processed anti-meal whose thermal completion intensifies while nutritional completion fails.

activation_trace.role: Ripening and flavor supply the focus-side expectation that processing should culminate in edible value.
The pot nearing doneness anchors the processed-meal image directly in ضريع.
Encountering fire supplies the heating environment around the focus ration.
Blazing fire intensifies processing from generic warmth to active combustion.
Heating names the thermal operation that links fire to the near-done vessel.
Administered drinking moves the heated material from environment toward bodily intake.
Reaching full maturity supplies the completion point that the food process reaches only as harmful intensity.

structural_cues: Fire and intensely matured drink immediately precede the food clause, while failed nourishment immediately follows it.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies fire, heating, mature intensity, intake, ripening, and near-doneness; I connect them as one preparation process. A live alternative keeps fire, drink, and plant as separate items with no shared culinary mechanism.

changed_reading.before: The ration is a raw or merely named plant.
changed_reading.after: The ration is an engineered anti-meal: processing reaches heat and maturity, but what is completed is harm rather than nourishment.

context_deltas.mechanism: The follow-up tests the sole exception against two core food functions and cancels both. ضريع remains grammatically inside the food slot while operating as food's functional negation.

activation_trace.role: Categorical negation provides the outer denial that the failed exception effectively reinstates.
Food as tasting, eating, and satisfying hunger supplies the prototype placed under test.
Emaciation makes the sole food resemble the very failure food should reverse.
The gain opposed to emaciation is explicitly denied as an output.
Sufficiency supplies a functional criterion that the exception fails.
Bodily emptiness persists, canceling the exception's claim to satisfy.

structural_cues: The two coordinated negations in 88:7 immediately predicate failed outcomes of the sole item in 88:6.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies ordinary food functions and their explicit failure; I infer a prototype cancellation in which the exception is nominally food but functionally anti-food. A live alternative allows a substance to remain food even when it nourishes badly.

changed_reading.before: The exception leaves one inferior but recognizable food.
changed_reading.after: The exception is a category trap: it occupies the name 'food' while reinstating 'no food' at the level of bodily function.

context_deltas.mechanism: The positive scene distributes provision through flow, vessels, deliberate placement, alignment, and spread. Focus branches expose feeding and offering as relations between giver and recipient, so the negative ration becomes a collapse of hospitality, not merely a bad ingredient.

activation_trace.role: Feeding another and asking to be fed make nourishment an interpersonal delivery relation.
Offering property turns the sole item into a degraded gift or allocation.
Good condition supplies the recipient-state achieved by the contrasting provision system.
Continuous provision supplies an uninterrupted delivery channel.
The drinking vessel gives provision a usable recipient-facing form.
Placement in an appointed position supplies deliberate readiness for use.
Orderly alignment supplies coordinated service rather than random availability.
Distribution and spreading complete the image of provision arranged around recipients.

structural_cues: The positive tableau moves from recipient condition to flowing source and then to objects placed, aligned, and spread.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies feeding, offering, flow, vessels, and arrangement; I infer a hospitality system and read the focus as its negative mirror. A live alternative treats the later furnishings as reward imagery unrelated to the mechanics of feeding.

changed_reading.before: The problem lies entirely in the substance served.
changed_reading.after: The problem also lies in a failed giver-recipient relation: the only offer degrades, while the contrasting scene makes provision flow and stand ready for use.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later material sequence can be assembled into a pastoral nourishment circuit: measured creation, sky-borne rain, fertile spreading earth, plants, tended camels, and milk rising in udders. The focus compresses that productive circuit into a dry plant and the lexical trace of an udder, with nourishment absent.

activation_trace.role: Provision and livelihood provide the output expected from the reconstructed ecological circuit.
Udder and milk anchor the circuit's animal nourishment endpoint inside the focus word.
The dry named plant anchors the circuit's collapsed vegetal residue inside the same focus word.
Camels and their tending supply the herd that can convert forage into nourishment.
Measure and proportion supply the designed fit among the circuit's material parts.
The non-dominant mapped image of first rain marking earth with growth supplies water-to-vegetation activation.
Milk rising in the udder explicitly links the raised-sky context back to the milk-bearing focus branch.
Soft fertile earth supplies the ground in which nourishment-bearing growth should occur.
A plant spreading over the ground completes the forage side of the circuit.

structural_cues: The branchless root ك ي ف repeats at 88:17-20 and is used only as a structural invitation to inspect how the camel, sky, mountains, and earth are made.
The ordered material sequence permits, but does not itself state, an ecological linkage.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies every component and the milk/rain/plant branch images; I supply the arrows rain to fertile growth to herd to milk. A live alternative is that the four created objects are independent signs and should not be assembled into a food circuit.

changed_reading.before: ضريع is an isolated bad plant placed on a closed menu.
changed_reading.after: ضريع is the collapsed remainder of an entire pastoral provision circuit: plant and udder remain as signs, while growth-to-milk nourishment has failed.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later repetition of present negation denies controlling oversight to the reminder. This limits a reading in which the speaking reminder personally administers or coerces the focus ration, while leaving the ration's coercive structure intact.

activation_trace.role: Present-state negation supplies the repeated form whose second use reallocates agency.
Feeding another exposes the possible feeder role that the later agency boundary constrains.
Reminder and reminder-object define the human addressee's stated function.
The repeated present denial excludes control from that reminder's current role.
Dominating oversight names precisely the administrative agency being denied.

structural_cues: ليس recurs at 88:22 in a direct denial of the reminder's control.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies reminder, repeated negation, and denied control; I infer that the reminder should not be cast as the ration's administrator. A live alternative is that the two negations are locally independent and do not constrain narrative agency.

changed_reading.before: The ration can be imagined as directly imposed by the human voice that announces it.
changed_reading.after: The announcing human role is bounded to reminder rather than control, so administration of the ration must be located elsewhere or left unstated.

context_deltas.mechanism: Turning away and covering blessing can be read reciprocally against food-as-provision: refusal and concealment return as a provision whose sole content is need and wasting.

activation_trace.role: Provision and livelihood supply the good that can be covered and then inverted.
Need and submission supply the reciprocal form taken by the inverted provision.
Wasting supplies the bodily consequence of provision reversed into deprivation.
Turning away supplies the initiating relation of refusal.
Covering a blessing supplies the specific object of refusal that the ration can invert.

structural_cues: The later pair of turning away and covering follows the reminder/control boundary and identifies a recipient response.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies refusal, covered blessing, provision, need, and wasting; I supply the reciprocal arrow from covered provision to deprivation-as-provision. A live alternative is that 88:23 identifies culpability without explaining the material form of 88:6.

changed_reading.before: The scarcity is an impersonal condition.
changed_reading.after: The ration can coexist with a reciprocal reading: covered provision returns as an allotment that manifests need rather than relieving it.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later punishment root carries sweetness of food and water, bodily abstention from intake, withholding or weaning, and inflicted pain. Those branches gather the focus into a deprivation process: punishment is not only what is eaten but the removal of sweetness, appetite, and nourishment through eating.

activation_trace.role: Taste, food, and hunger-relief supply the nourishing functions subjected to punitive reversal.
Emaciation supplies the body produced when nourishment is withheld in the act of intake.
Sweetness and goodness in water or food name the positive sensory value removed from the ration.
The body's abstention from food and drink turns punishment into blocked intake or appetite.
Withholding and weaning supply the directional operation that deprives while food remains present.
Painful punishment identifies the juridical force into which the food mechanism is gathered.

structural_cues: The later explicit naming of the greatest punishment retrospectively gathers the earlier fire, drink, food, and hunger sequence.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies sweetness, abstention, weaning, punishment, food, and emaciation; I infer that deprivation is an operative mode of punishment. A live alternative restricts the punishment branch to inflicted pain and leaves the food sequence as a separate penalty.

changed_reading.before: Punishment consists of being given a painful food object.
changed_reading.after: Punishment also operates as weaning from nourishment itself: intake persists, but sweetness, sufficiency, and bodily repair are withheld.

context_deltas.mechanism: Return followed by reckoning activates the possessive and restrictive grammar of the focus as an allocation statement. Food-as-allotted share becomes a counted entitlement whose sole entry is precisely what cannot suffice.

activation_trace.role: Exclusion reduces the recipients' account to one admissible entry.
Allotted share, revenue, and livelihood make food legible as an assigned entitlement.
Return to the place of return supplies the transition into final allocation.
Counting and accounting supply the formal operation that fixes the ration's entry.
Sufficiency supplies an ironic accounting criterion because the allotted food has already failed it.

structural_cues: The focus uses a recipient possessive and an exclusive allotment; the surah closes with return and reckoning.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies return, counting, sufficiency, and food as allotted share; I infer an adjudicated ration recorded at reckoning. A live alternative keeps reckoning moral and refuses any retrospective allocation sense in the food clause.

changed_reading.before: The clause merely reports what food is available.
changed_reading.after: The clause can read like an accounted allotment: their sole recorded share is an anti-provision that is counted yet cannot suffice.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it joins remote focus branches for throat-gripping and rope strands to the non-dominant split mapping of س ق ي as driving. It remains anchored in the food and ضريع words and in the exact administered-drink context, but downstream prose should present it only as an exploratory mechanical overlay, never as a lexical gloss of the verse.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: طعام has a throat-seizing branch and ضريع has a rope-strand branch, both attached to the only intake named in the focus.

activation_trace.role: Gripping and squeezing the throat converts the food pathway into a site of restraint.
Rope strands supply the material image of a harness or constricting line.
The non-dominant mapped image of driving or herding supplies coercive motion toward intake.

changed_reading.before: The food is a passive harmful substance.
changed_reading.after: The food briefly activates as an intake apparatus: a strand-like ration driven toward a throat that it grips rather than feeds.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the ordinary plant reading is crossed with an udder branch and a later, unusually exact milk-rising branch. It remains strongly anchored in ضريع and in the camel and رفع citations, but it should be rendered as a latent lactation reversal, not as a claim that ضريع denotes milk here.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus word ضريع itself carries the udder-and-milk branch while naming the sole food.

activation_trace.role: Negation supplies the withholding frame around the expected nourishing yield.
Udder and milk place a source of animal nourishment inside the sole food's branch field.
Camels and their tending supply the animal body to which the udder image belongs.
Milk rising in the udder supplies an exact latent yield that the focus's negative ration withholds.

changed_reading.before: ضريع contributes only the image of a hostile plant.
changed_reading.after: The word also carries a lactation-negative echo: the organ and rising of milk are activated, yet the sole ration yields no milk-like nourishment.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it lets the sole 'food' exception migrate into a thin-drink branch under pressure from drinking and cups. It remains anchored in all three focus roots and branch-backed context, but downstream prose should qualify it as category slippage rather than replace the plant reading with a beverage.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus juxtaposes categorical food denial with an exception whose ضريع branch can name a thin drink.

activation_trace.role: Exception supplies the narrow gate through which a category-edge item enters.
Taste and nourishing intake allow drink to count as food only by function.
The thin-drink image supplies the marginal substance that destabilizes the exception's category.
Giving drink activates the beverage side immediately before the food clause.
The cup supplies a contrasting vessel in which drink is usable and recipient-ready.

changed_reading.before: One solid food survives the categorical denial.
changed_reading.after: The surviving item can hover between food and thin drink, so the exception restores a grammatical item without securely restoring nourishment.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates a temporal sunset branch of ضريع with the later return of the sun to its resting place. It remains anchored in the sole focus item and a precise return branch, but downstream prose should treat it as a terminal-time resonance, not as the ordinary referent of ضريع.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: A ضريع branch pictures the sun nearing sunset, placing an approach-to-ending image inside the only food.

activation_trace.role: The sun nearing its setting turns the ration into an image of terminal approach.
The sky as the elevated cover supplies the spatial field of the sunset image.
Sunset returning to its resting place links terminal light to the surah's final return.

changed_reading.before: The sole ration is only a spatially present substance.
changed_reading.after: The ration can carry a terminal temporal echo: nourishment is replaced by perpetual approach to setting and return.

strongest_changes: The immediate sequel converts the sole exception from inferior food into functional anti-food: it bears the category name while canceling repair and hunger-relief.
Labor, exhaustion, emaciation, and persistent hunger form a feed-forward mechanism in which provision reproduces the need it should end.
The later creation sequence activates a collapsed pastoral circuit in which rain, earth, plants, camels, udders, and milk are present as branch-images but nourishing conversion fails.
The punishment and reckoning roots recast the ration as punitive weaning and as a counted allotment that is assigned yet cannot suffice.
summary.what_was_special: The focus's three roots supported several coexisting scales at once: literal menu closure, metabolic failure, labor compensation, hospitality, ecology, punishment, and accounting. Split-root cues were especially productive when kept distinct: س ق ي opened an exploratory driving mechanism, while س م و opened a rain-marked vegetation circuit.
remaining_uncertainties: The plant branch of ضريع is direct, while its udder, near-doneness, rope, thin-drink, and sunset branches may be latent resonances rather than active senses in this occurrence.

The feed-forward and functional-cancellation models are textually tight, but the compensation, hospitality, ecological, and reciprocal-refusal models depend on reader-supplied arrows across separated context units.
It remains uncertain whether food-as-provision and allotted share should govern the focus strongly enough to sustain the wage and reckoning readings alongside the physiological reading.
